name: remote-sensing-VQA-benchmark
description:
Adapting Multimodal Large Language Models to Domains via Post-Training (EMNLP 2025)
	

This repos contains the remote sensing visual instruction tasks for evaluating MLLMs in our paper: On Domain-Specific Post-Training for Multimodal Large Language Models.
The main project page is: Adapt-MLLM-to-Domains

	
		
	
	
		1. Download Data
	

You can load datasets using the datasets library:  
from datasets import load_dataset

# Choose the task name from the list of available tasks
task_name… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AdaptLLM/remote-sensing-VQA-benchmark.
reputation: Dataset released alongside an EMNLP 2025 study for domain-specific MLLM post-training; moderately used in remote-sensing MLLM adaptation research.
